cards.title: Observe producer and consumer behavior
cards.assignment: Inspect LocalPolicyIssueController and PolicyIssueRequest. Record the two operations, auth boundary, request fields, returned status codes, and independent expected field sets. Do not change application behavior.
cards.acceptance: OpenAPICompatibilityInfrastructureTest: operation set and source DTO fields are fixed independently.

cards.title: Complete the versioned API description
cards.assignment: Edit src/main/resources/contracts/coverstory-policies-v1.json to describe the existing POST and GET routes, request/response schemas, auth, and exact status variants including POST 200/201/400/401/404/409. Preserve the independent fixture assertions.
cards.acceptance: Infrastructure checks resolve required fields/statuses and reject undocumented or extra controller operations.

source.title: OpenAPI 3.2.1
source.section: 4.8 Paths Object; 4.10 Operation Object; 4.24 Schema Object

cards.title: Compare the contract with actual Spring mappings
cards.assignment: Extend OpenApiCompatibilityInfrastructureTest to compare documented verb/path pairs against LocalPolicyIssueController annotations; include method, missing-route, and extra-route counterfactuals.
cards.acceptance: Actual Spring annotations and contract operation sets must be equal; mutants adding/removing a route fail.

cards.title: Evaluate consumer compatibility for provider changes
cards.assignment: Implement the compatibility learner seam for additive optional response fields versus removed consumed fields, new required request fields, changed response status, and changed field types.
cards.acceptance: Independent expected diagnostics verify exact changed operations and preserve optional additions as compatible.

cards.title: Run compatibility mutation controls and capture evidence
cards.assignment: Run the compatibility witness against unchanged, additive, and breaking documents; introduce a deliberate always-compatible mutant and confirm the independent actual-path assertion rejects it.
cards.acceptance: The immutable expected operation/field/status diagnostics reject always-compatible and wrong-diagnostic mutants.

cards.title: Define an isolated resource-server lab seam
cards.assignment: Review the isolated oidc-contract-lab profile and loopback-only synthetic issuer. Trace the learner policy seam; preserve the existing cookie-session configuration and never configure an external issuer.
cards.acceptance: Infrastructure test proves issuer/JWKS URLs are loopback-only and the profile is separate from application sessions.

cards.title: Route bearer authentication through Spring Security
cards.assignment: Trace the real SecurityFilterChain, issuer/time validator, audience validator, and default-deny route handling. Implement OidcTenantPolicy separately; do not replace token verification with a mock Authentication.
cards.acceptance: Actual MockMvc bearer path proves valid signed tokens reach authorization and invalid tokens fail before the handler.

cards.title: Exercise provider discovery and JWKS signature verification
cards.assignment: Use the disposable local issuer's discovery metadata and JWKS. Follow one signed synthetic token through discovery, key selection, signature verification, and the protected handler.
cards.acceptance: The test observes a real signed bearer request and successful protected response; mock tokens are not accepted by this path.

source.title: Spring Security
source.section: Specifying the Authorization Server; Startup Expectations

cards.title: Reject issuer, audience, time, and malformed-token failures
cards.assignment: Use independently signed wrong-issuer, wrong-audience, expired, and malformed tokens. Assert HTTP 401, no private body, and no successful handler response.
cards.acceptance: Each counterfactual is independently expected to fail authentication and expose no synthetic subject.

cards.title: Reject unknown key identifiers and invalid token structure
cards.assignment: Exercise malformed compact token and a validly signed token whose kid is absent from the JWKS. Confirm the filter chain returns 401 without claim disclosure.
cards.acceptance: Unknown kid and malformed token controls fail on actual decoder path; no unsigned-token bypass.

cards.title: Test key rotation and overlap
cards.assignment: Use only the local synthetic issuer. Verify the previously active and newly published key IDs during overlap, then an unknown-key denial; record that this lab does not establish immediate revocation behavior.
cards.acceptance: Positive controls for both published keys and a negative unknown-key control exercise JWKS retrieval.

cards.title: Enforce tenant ownership in the authorization path
cards.assignment: Implement the learner OidcTenantPolicy using exact tenant claim equality. Reject foreign, absent, blank, and wrongly typed claims; the instructor witness remains separate from learner implementation.
cards.acceptance: Same-tenant positive control and malformed/foreign-tenant negative controls use fixed claims.

cards.title: Apply least-privilege scope checks
cards.assignment: Require the exact policy.read permission for this GET route. Verify policy.write, unknown scopes, substrings, blank scopes, and tenant mismatch do not authorize.
cards.acceptance: The acceptance matrix tests scope tokenization and tenant relation independently.

cards.title: Run full protocol and authorization acceptance
cards.assignment: Run the complete isolated protocol suite and learner policy acceptance. Preserve the actual issuer/JWKS test path and record any failure as a blocker, not completion.
cards.acceptance: Protocol infrastructure and learner authorization acceptance are separately reported.

cards.title: Pin the baseline rows and compatibility boundary
cards.assignment: Use disposable embedded PostgreSQL and migration V001 in the isolated schema-evolution lab. Record exact fixture IDs/values and create an independent expected row map for old and new readers.
cards.acceptance: Fixed expected rows and schema columns are asserted before any candidate migration.

cards.title: Apply an additive expand migration
cards.assignment: Apply the lab's versioned nullable column migration. Verify the preexisting rows remain exact, old insert/read SQL still works, and the new column accepts a value.
cards.acceptance: Independent row snapshot is byte-stable across expansion and an old-shape insert remains valid.

cards.title: Backfill bounded batches with a durable cursor
cards.assignment: Implement the resumable backfill learner seam over stable integer IDs using bounded ordered batches and a stored cursor. The expected target values and IDs are fixed independently.
cards.acceptance: Acceptance compares exact IDs, values, cursor and total row count after each bounded batch.

cards.title: Interrupt and resume without skips or duplicates
cards.assignment: Run two batches, close the runner, recreate it from the persisted cursor, and finish. Reject malformed/out-of-range cursors and record exact row-state before and after restart.
cards.acceptance: Independent exact final rows and per-ID update counts prove restart correctness; wrong cursor mutant fails.

shared_interview_block.task: Practice Q18 only in the interview question bank; record an answer before hints. No capstone design decision or proposal.

cards.title: Check old/new reader and writer compatibility
cards.assignment: Execute fixed old-shape read/write SQL before and after backfill, and new-shape reads after it. Verify exact row sets and that the additive field does not break old code paths.
cards.acceptance: Actual SQL queries for both schema generations match independent expected rows.

shared_interview_block.task: Practice Q19 only in the interview question bank; record an answer before hints. No capstone design decision or proposal.

cards.title: Reject destructive change and demonstrate forward recovery
cards.assignment: Prove a destructive candidate migration fails the schema/row acceptance boundary. Recover only by applying a forward migration in a fresh disposable DB and compare exact rows.
cards.acceptance: A dropped-column mutant is rejected; forward migration restores the expected schema/values without claiming rollback semantics.

shared_interview_block.task: Practice Q20 only in the interview question bank; record an answer before hints. No capstone design decision or proposal.

cards.title: Verify cleanup eligibility and publish migration evidence
cards.assignment: In a new disposable database, run the full expand/backfill/compatibility sequence and only contract after an independent retired-reader fixture says removal is safe. Capture exact migration history and row digest.
cards.acceptance: Contract precondition is tested both true and false; exact expected rows, column set, and Flyway history are checked.

shared_interview_block.task: Practice Q21 only in the interview question bank; record an answer before hints. No capstone design decision or proposal.
